teacher_info.about_teacher:
I received my TEFL certification in Prague, Czech Republic, and have taught English to learners of all levels in group classes and one-on-one lessons. I have also volunteered in school classrooms, working with English language learners in developing their reading skills, as well as participating in language exchange during university.

My goal as a teacher is to make you feel comfortable, supported, and encouraged. Conversations flow more naturally when we feel secure, so I create an environment in which you feel you can communicate freely, and you do not feel afraid to make mistakes. You'll build confidence and knowledge with me as your biggest cheerleader.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I aim to make our lessons very enjoyable, and focused on your goals and interests. Speaking and conversation practice will usually be our main focus, because improving this skill leads to more confidence with the language, easier application of the language in real-world situations, and an increased vocabulary. It also allows us to identify grammatical challenges you may be facing, so we can work on those together, using materials I have developed that have proven to be very effective in helping my students better understand different grammar forms. During our conversations, I will give you corrections (verbally and through typed notes in our chat). With me, you'll have fun while you learn!

We will discuss a wide variety of topics so that you can get comfortable talking about many different subjects. Along the way, I will give you corrections and suggest new vocabulary and expressions to help you better express yourself. We will also focus on grammar, pronunciation, and intonation to help you sound more natural. Conversations may be free-flowing or focus on a specific topic, and we will sometimes read short articles to learn new vocabulary in context, and give us another subject to discuss. 

If there is anything you would like to focus on, such as grammar, something you would like to learn, such as common expressions, or a topic you would like to discuss, please always feel free to let me know. I want to help you meet your goals, whatever they may be, and to ensure our class time is enjoyable for you. I always welcome suggestions, requests, and feedback.

I teach muscle memory, speed, and tonality. (Remember the goal is to speak like a native!) Everyone learns grammar from a school, but how can we learn to have a casual conversation? By talking, of course! With conversation practice, you will be given prompts to answer as quickly and naturally as you can. Or you can simply choose to have a casual conversation! Every lesson can be customized for each student's needs and interests. Do you have a particular hobby or topic you enjoy? Is there one part of English that you struggle with more than others? pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation & Accent Training
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the Pronunciation & Accent Training ESL English program! As an experienced language instructor, I am dedicated to helping you develop clear and confident English pronunciation, and to refine your accent to effectively communicate in any English-speaking setting.
In this specialized course, we will focus on several key areas to enhance your pronunciation and accent:
Phonetics & Sounds: We will explore the different sounds present in the English language, paying particular attention to those that may not exist in your native language. Through interactive exercises and drills, you will learn to produce these sounds accurately.
Word Stress & Intonation: Understanding word stress and intonation patterns is essential for natural and expressive speech. You will master the rhythm and melody of English, making your speech more engaging and easy to understand.
Vowel & Consonant Sounds: We will dive deep into English vowel and consonant sounds, addressing common challenges and helping you articulate them with precision.
Reduced Speech & Linking: English speakers often link words together and use reduced speech in everyday conversation. You will learn these techniques to sound more like a native speaker and improve your listening comprehension.
Accents & Regional Variations: While achieving a neutral accent is the primary goal, we also embrace and appreciate various English accents and regional variations. You will gain exposure to different accents, helping you adapt to diverse English-speaking environments.
Remember, perfect pronunciation is not the goal. Our aim is to help you communicate clearly and confidently, embracing your unique voice while developing a solid foundation in English pronunciation!
